page.overview:
Who is Kin'emon?

"Foxfire" Kin'emon is a samurai from the region of Kuri in Wano Country who currently serves the shogunate as a in the Flower Capital. Once a thug in his youth, he became a retainer of the Kouzuki Family and the leader of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. He was born 56 years before the present day, but traveled 20 years forward in time when he was 36 years old.

Due to Wano Country having been taken over by Shogun Kurozumi Orochi, an ally of Kaidou of the Four Emperors, Kin'emon set out on a seafaring quest to recruit warriors for his cause, bringing alongside him his master Kouzuki Momonosuke and his fellow retainers Kanjuro and Raizo. After a series of misadventures, Kin'emon ended up on the island of Punk Hazard, where he met and joined forces with the Straw Hat Pirates, posing as Momonosuke's father during the journey to Zou.

He is one of the central allies of the Straw Hats during the Dressrosa, Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas.

Kin'emon's appearance matches the stereotype of samurai found in ancient Japan, with a black topknot and goatee. At 295 cm (9'8"), he is taller than Brook who stands at 277 cm (9'1"). He is also quite muscular. His eyes are asymmetrical, with his right eye opening more than his left.
